name: @pipeworx/mcp-blockscout

tools.name: get_address
tools.description: "What's the balance of [wallet]" / "Ethereum / Polygon / Arbitrum / Base wallet info" / "address summary for [0x...]" / "what tokens does [wallet] hold" — on-chain address summary across 20+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Optimism, Polygon, Arbitrum, Base, BNB, Gnosis, Celo, zkSync, Scroll, Linea, Blast, …). Returns balance, transaction count, token-holding stats. Pass chain slug + 0x address.

tools.name: get_address_txns
tools.description: "Recent transactions of [wallet]" / "tx history for [0x...]" / "what has [address] done lately" — recent transactions for an EVM address. Pass chain + 0x address; optionally filter by direction (to/from). Use for wallet-activity audit, fund-flow tracing.

tools.name: get_address_token_transfers
tools.description: "Token transfers / NFT activity for [wallet]" / "ERC-20 / ERC-721 / ERC-1155 transfers in/out of [0x...]" / "what tokens did [address] send or receive" — token transfer log for an EVM address. Use for tracing NFT activity, stablecoin flows, airdrops, or specific-token movement (filter via `token` arg).

token.description: Restrict to a specific token contract

tools.name: get_transaction
tools.description: "Look up transaction [0xhash]" / "what happened in tx [hash]" / "decode tx [X]" — full transaction detail (from, to, value, method, status, gas, decoded calldata). Pass chain + tx_hash. Use for forensic tx analysis, MEV inspection, contract-call breakdown.

tools.name: get_token
tools.description: "Token info for [contract]" / "what is contract [0x...]" / "ERC-20 / NFT metadata for [token]" — token contract metadata: name, symbol, decimals, total supply, holder count, contract type. Use for on-chain token characterization.

tools.name: get_block
tools.description: "Block [N] details" / "what was in block [hash]" / "miner / proposer of block [X]" — block detail by number or hash. Returns timestamp, gas used, transaction count, miner / validator, parent / next blocks. Use for chain forensics, block-time analysis.

tools.name: search
tools.description: "Search [chain] for [query]" / "is [string] a token / contract / address on [chain]" — universal block-explorer search across addresses, transactions, blocks, tokens, and ENS-style names on a specific EVM chain. Use when you don't know yet whether the input is an address / hash / token symbol.

tools.name: list_chains
tools.description: List all EVM chain slugs and Blockscout host URLs supported by this pack (20+ chains: eth, polygon, arbitrum, base, optimism, bnb, gnosis, zksync-era, etc.). Use to discover valid chain values for other tools.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-blockscout forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the blockscout pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
